metadata.description: Hub name: the DNS label (<name>.<region>.azurecontainer.io) and the prefix of the resources. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
Azure region (default: the resource group's).
longarm-hub image. Pin a version (ghcr.io/<owner>/longarm-hub:X.Y.Z) for reproducible upgrades; :latest is the newest release, :edge the main branch.
Hub size: small = 1 vCPU / 1.5 GB, medium = 2 vCPU / 3 GB.

Serve the web panel and install scripts over HTTPS on 80/443 with a Let's Encrypt certificate for the azurecontainer.io name: a Caddy sidecar (storageAuth key), or the hub itself with the certificate in its replicated database (storageAuth identity).
E-mail for Let's Encrypt expiry notices (optional).
Caddy image of the panel sidecar (pinned by digest; point it at a mirror if Docker Hub rate limits bite).
Send container logs to a new Log Analytics workspace (about 2-3 USD per GB ingested).
Storage redundancy of the account holding the Litestream replica and the state share.
Lifetime in hours of the one-time admin join code created on the first start.

UDP port of the longnet relay (QUIC + STUN); the second STUN port is this + 1. Not 7443: ACI refuses one port number for TCP and UDP (DuplicateIpAddressPorts); workers listen on longnet://<fqdn>:<port>?tcp=<fqdn>:7443.
Expiry of the Litestream SAS (blob container scoped); every deployment (deploy.sh re-run) renews it.

How the hub reaches its storage account. key: the account key (Azure Files share for the data dir, a SAS for Litestream). identity: a user-assigned managed identity with Storage Blob Data Contributor on the replica container and shared key access off, for subscriptions whose policy denies it: no file shares, the data dir is the container's own disk and the CA is kept in the replicated database (LONGARM_HUB_CA_IN_DB), and the hub serves the panel over https itself (no Caddy; its certificate in the database too). Needs Owner or User Access Administrator on the resource group (role assignments).
storageAuth identity: pull the image from this Azure Container Registry (in this resource group) with the managed identity (AcrPull). Empty: registryUsername or anonymous.
Registry login for a private image (empty = anonymous pull).
Optional Tailscale OAuth client secret for the hub's [tailnet] provider (deploy/hub/README.md "Tailnet provider").

metadata.description: Hub address for longarm join / longarmd join.
Web panel and install scripts (empty without the panel).

storageAuth identity: the managed identity's principal ID (empty with key).
